Now go to settings and accounts delete Google accounts after deleting it you. Just need to restart your phone don't enable your Wi-Fi connection right now. Restart your phone now. After restart enable Wi-Fi or your data pack open Chrome. It will ask you to sign but don't sign in. Now search.
